description: This Java file defines an enum called IntentFlag representing various Android intent flags, along with their properties like complements, conflicts, and requests. It also contains methods to access these properties and a static helper method to create sets of flags.

classes.name: IntentFlag
classes.description: An enum representing Android intent flags with relationships such as complements, conflicts, and requests.

methods.name: getComplements
methods.description: Returns the set of intent flags that complement this flag.

methods.name: getConflicts
methods.description: Returns the set of intent flags that conflict with this flag.

methods.name: getRequests
methods.description: Returns the set of intent flags that are necessary for this flag.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name string of this intent flag.

methods.name: setOf
methods.description: Convenience method to create a set of IntentFlag instances from varargs.
